title: Police ramp up security ahead of planned July 31 shutdown over constitutional changes
desc: THE Zimbabwe Republic Police (ZRP) says it has deployed officers across the country to maintain law and order ahead of a planned nationwide shutdown on Friday, as political tensions mount following the enactment of Constitutional Amendment Act No. 3 (CAA3). The security assurance comes amid growing calls by opposition groups, civil society organisations and government […]

title: South Island set for first direct international internet cable
desc: Southland and Australia look set to be linked by the first international submarine cable to land in New Zealand's South Island, as plans advance for a massive data centre in the region.

title: Japan earthquake survivors battle heat stroke in sweltering conditions as death toll rises
desc: At least 34 people have been killed after a 7.1-magnitude earthquake struck Japan, with 9,000 others displaced across the country's south-west.

title: Failing to Tackle Inequality Puts Countries in Pandemic Danger
desc: Many countries that score highest on standard measures of pandemic preparedness did not fared well during the COVID-19 and AIDS pandemics.

title: Keshta finishes seventh in +110kg weightlifting final

title: Passports with Trump's photo will be easier to get
desc: Americans outside the nation’s capital will soon be able to get limited-edition U.S. passports that feature a picture of President Donald Trump and celebrate America’s 250th birthday.

title: Georgia father sentenced to 15 years in deadly school shooting committed by son
desc: A man who gave his son the gun he used to kill two students and two teachers at Apalachee High School in Georgia was sentenced Thursday to 15 years in prison.

title: Dual immunotherapy with neoadjuvant chemotherapy shows encouraging activity in ERBB2-negative breast cancer
desc: A combination of two immunotherapy drugs showed encouraging activity when added to standard chemotherapy given prior to surgery for patients with high-risk, early-stage HER2-negative breast cancer, according to phase 2 clinical trial results from the ongoing I-SPY2 clinical trial platform.

title: 40 years, no floods. Now her Montreal home's been hit 3 straight years. What's changed?
desc: After decades without flooding, some Montreal-area homeowners have seen their basements fill with water three years in a row. Experts say heavier rain, aging infrastructure and urban development all play a role — and adapting to a changing climate will require more than one solution.
